blocks.orig: Ole Serai Luxury Camp Kogatende is located in the northern part of Serengeti National Park where it is set amidst one of the prime areas where the great migration passes. Due to the camp’s ideal location, the great spectacle of the world-famous annual migration can be witnessed practically from the camp’s doorsteps. The ensuite tents and the guest areas have been specifically designed to offer an optimum 180-degree view from the covered verandas. And even when you lie in bed or enjoy a meal in the restaurant, you are as close to nature as possible. The stunning views and the abundance of animals in the vicinity make the Ole Serai experience awe-inspiring.
blocks.html: In the north of Serengeti National Park, Ole Serai Luxury Camp Kogatende sits in one of the best areas along the route of the great migration. Thanks to this ideal spot, you can watch the world-famous yearly migration almost from the doorstep of the camp. The ensuite tents and the shared spaces were designed especially to give the best possible 180-degree view from the covered verandas. Even while you lie in bed or have a meal in the restaurant, nature is as close as it can be. With its stunning views and the many animals around, a stay at Ole Serai is truly awe-inspiring.
